name: movie-1-start
description: #76: movie, its start. From the title boot point with a blank card (title-card), New Game (title-to-new-game, 720 frames, as in new-game-to-reactor-entrance), then Circle every second until Stframe_no (movie_frame) is no longer 0: movie_start is the first frame it is not, counted from the end of title-to-new-game. Stframe_no reads 0 from New Game until the opening movie streams its first frame (it can also read 0 on single frames later in the movie, attempt 1 at script frame 1920; the first non-zero read is the start). The opening movie is played by the field module, so g_GameState reads field (1) during it (mode_ok). match: a rerun from the same snapshot. Keeps "movie-start".
